items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks from hamstring; was listed questionable but took starter reps.
items.why: Full practice week without setbacks after missing three games with torn hamstring.
items.implication: Returns as starter; boosts Bears pass-catchers and overall offense vs Falcons.
items.opportunity: Full snaps expected; high implied total and Atlanta pass D favorable.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after IR stint for high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Returned to practice this week; activated off IR, limited but progressing.
items.implication: Immediate WR1 upside in NE offense vs Jets; start if active as projected.
items.opportunity: High target share expected on return; monitor snap count/ankle management.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve after consultations on his blood clot; out indefinitely. Tanner McKee starts Sunday and beyond for now.
items.why: Superficial blood clot in calf; doctors consultations into Saturday led to IR move.
items.implication: Indefinite absence; McKee full-time starter short-term; Eagles offense downgraded significantly.
items.opportunity: Pass-catcher volume to DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Dontayvion Wicks remains but with lower efficiency/QB play; thin RB room (Dameon Pierce lead).

items.text: Steelers WR DK Metcalf (illness) removed from injury report; no designation for Sunday vs Bucs. Freiermuth (calf) added as questionable.
items.implication: Full go; heavy usage expected in 2-WR sets with Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek out.
items.opportunity: Elevated target/route share in thin PIT WR room.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin). Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable. PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf/Bernard. PHI McKee has top-4 pass-catchers healthy (Smith/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB.
items.why: Practice reports and designations; Friday additions and thin depth charts.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; lean in on probable tags and Metcalf volume; PHI pass-catchers viable with McKee.
items.opportunity: Metcalf route/target spike in 2-WR; PHI top pass-catchers maintain opportunity despite QB/RB issues.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 6 (hamstring); joins Hurts and Will Shipley on Eagles inactive list.
items.why: Hamstring injury; missed practice and ruled out.
items.implication: No Saquon; backfield to Dameon Pierce/4th-string options with thin room.
items.opportunity: Pierce lead back low-end RB2 in thin week; pass game still primary.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday (ankle).
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts; Ravens offense limited, Flowers/Andrews still viable but lower ceiling.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT (quad) along with AD Mitchell.

items.implication: Texans RB snaps shift; handcuff/backup elevated for carries/goal-line.

items.text: Rashee Rice listed OUT (hamstring) with Tyquan Thornton.
items.implication: Chiefs WR targets redistribute to Worthy/others; Kelce still primary.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and remaining WRs see bump in routes/targets.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.implication: Depth WR addition with Lamar out; monitor for snaps/routes.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans (vs WSH WR4), Drake London (vs CHI WR6), George Kittle (vs WSH TE3) for soft Commanders D and bankable usage/roles.
items.why: Washington D nightmare for WR/TE; London/Golden usage reliable.
items.implication: Strong start candidates in favorable spots.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone potential vs weak pass D.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (vs ARI RB5), Javonte Williams (@GB RB8), Rhamondre Stevenson (vs NYJ RB9) for volume and leaking run defenses; Kyren elite usage, Javonte goal-line role.
items.why: Volume + soft run D matchups; goal-line work for Javonte.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (vs CHI), J.K. Dobbins (vs SEA), Bo Nix (vs SEA), Justin Herbert (@KC) due to tough matchups, shaky QB situations, low totals, or role issues.
items.why: Ugly matchups (SEA pass/run D), low team totals, limited recent targets/feeds, role problems.
